svg.title: Panowww: automated 360° panorama capture for video games
svg.desc: A looping demonstration on two displays. In Panowww, on the left, the Capture zone card opens and the zone is drawn over World of Warcraft on the right; a Session starts, the game turns its camera Step by Step while the Shots fill Panowww, and the 98 Shots end up stitched into a 360° panorama.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
